Scope Gate.rationale: Scope bounded and faithful to CKA-03: six in-scope items, five exclusions, four decisions all trace to the ticket; both verbatim acceptance criteria covered measurably (A-004, A-005/A-006) among twelve; the two open questions are non-blocking. Condition passed downstream: the default-branch push trigger runs BOTH verification surfaces - S-002/A-003 PR-only wording is imprecision, not an approved narrowing.

Planning Gate.rationale: Executable ten-task six-wave plan with dependency-forced ordering: orphan-run handling (T-010) and flip ownership (T-006) decided first, design (T-001) binds implementation, advisory-to-required flip (T-007) conditioned on evidence. Scope Gate condition preserved (A-001); all 12 scope criteria trace through T-008/T-009; R-008 (S8 orphans) structurally contained. Conditions: (1) T-009 evidence must include a default-branch push run executing verifier jobs; (2) A-001 both-surfaces-on-push reading is settled - the business analyst gate owner already confirmed it as the Scope Gate condition.

Design Gate.rationale: Design honors both Planning Gate conditions (both-surfaces-on-push hard constraint C-001/S-017; default-branch run with self-hosting verifier passing is the flip precondition D-003/P-006). Selected O-001 topology implementable on both platforms: runner-boundary isolation neutralizes the recovery verifier crash cascade, per-verifier check names satisfy failure naming, advisory-by-omission keeps week-one failures visible, NO_COLOR handled by declared absence. T-010 decided explicitly (clean-first). Additive-only verified (M-005 no-change-verified). Conditions for implementation: (1) confirm platform matrix fan-out and required-named-check facilities before P-003; (2) flip ownership recorded before merge; (3) fan-in checks demonstrated to fail, never skip, under upstream cancellation.

Review Gate.rationale: Review package RP-2026-0005 covers every contract dimension with constraint-by-constraint design-conformance checks and honest reported-vs-confirmed labeling; both findings (F-001 concurrency-claim overstatement, F-002 interpreter-floor coupling test gap) are correctly classified low and non-blocking; with zero critical/high/medium findings, approve-with-corrections is the verdict the adjudication table yields. CR-001/CR-002 travel to the implementer as open low corrections.

Verification Gate.rationale: QA re-executed the acceptance evidence: 13/13 ci-workflow contract tests OK; workflow YAML parses; discovery expression run locally enumerates exactly the 7 verifiers on disk; verify_manifests.py output matches the wrapper regex and all failing verdict forms on disk (NOT PROVEN/NOT COVERED/NOT SELF-HOSTING/NON-CONFORMANT) are rejected by the wrapper; both ticket criteria confirmed structurally (per-verifier check names carry the script name with fail-fast off and always()-guarded fan-ins; no concrete test/verifier filename appears in CI or blocking config); no framework-runtime path in declared side effects; NO_COLOR set nowhere. Recovery and self-hosting verifiers excluded by design (timing-sensitive; run in flight). Live hosted-run behavior remains reported-only and is routed to the advisory-window soak and flip preconditions.

Closure Gate.rationale: Release note faithfully and traceably describes the delivered CKA-03 change set (workflow, 13-test contract net, three documentation surfaces) and bounds its verification claims, labeling live hosted-run behavior as structurally verified only and routing confirmation to omn-qa. All open items (CR-001/CR-002, flip preconditions: soak, orphan cleanup, flip ownership, default-branch literal) carried honestly with named owners. Every upstream phase completed with passing validation and every upstream gate decided by a non-producer; no critical or high escalation open. Post-closure follow-ups logged: tech-lead enacts tests-ubuntu required at merge and records flip ownership; QA validates first live hosted runs; implementer lands CR-001/CR-002; orphan cleanup precedes the advisory-to-required flip.
